-- Install as ServerScriptService.BirthdayLobbyServer.
-- Every player owns a separate countdown. Clients cannot supply a destination or deadline.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local StarterPlayer = game:GetService("StarterPlayer")
local world = workspace:WaitForChild("CozyWorld_Draft01")
local lobby = world:WaitForChild("BirthdayLobby")
local lobbySpawn = lobby:WaitForChild("LobbySpawn")
local worldSpawn = world:WaitForChild("Arrival"):WaitForChild("ArrivalSpawn")
local destination = lobby:WaitForChild("WorldDestination")
local promptPart = lobby:WaitForChild("Portal"):WaitForChild("PortalPrompt")
local prompt = promptPart:WaitForChild("EnterWorld")
local countdownSeconds = math.clamp(lobby:GetAttribute("CountdownSeconds") or 60, 1, 60)
local center = lobby:GetAttribute("RegionCenter")
local size = lobby:GetAttribute("RegionSize")
local states = {}
local occupiedSlots = {}

local function allocateSlot(player)
	-- Reserve the lowest free slot once per connection, independent of UserId.
	-- The intended eight-player session occupies slots 0..7 without collisions.
	local slot = 0
	while occupiedSlots[slot] do slot += 1 end
	occupiedSlots[slot] = player
	return slot
end

local function liveCharacter(player)
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or character:GetAttribute("BirthdayPlacementReady")~=true then return nil end
	return character, root, humanoid
end

local function inLobby(root)
	local offset = root.Position - center
	return math.abs(offset.X) <= size.X/2 and math.abs(offset.Z) <= size.Z/2 and math.abs(offset.Y) <= size.Y/2
end

local function relocate(character, root, humanoid, target)
	local seat = humanoid.SeatPart
	humanoid.Sit = false
	if seat then
		local weld = seat:FindFirstChild("SeatWeld")
		if weld then weld:Destroy() end
	end
	root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
	character:PivotTo(target)
end

local function destinationFor(player)
	local slot = states[player].slot
	return destination.CFrame * CFrame.new((slot % 4 - 1.5) * 5, 0, math.floor(slot/4) * 5)
end

local function joinWorld(player, fromPad)
	local state = states[player]
	if not state or state.joined or state.moving then return false end
	local character, root, humanoid = liveCharacter(player)
	if not character or not inLobby(root) then return false end
	if fromPad and (root.Position - promptPart.Position).Magnitude > 10 then return false end
	if not fromPad and (not state.deadline or workspace:GetServerTimeNow() < state.deadline) then return false end
	state.moving = true
	-- No yielding between validation and the per-player state transition.
	character:SetAttribute("BirthdayPlacementReady",false)
	relocate(character, root, humanoid, destinationFor(player))
	state.joined = true
	state.deadline = nil
	state.moving = false
	player.RespawnLocation = worldSpawn
	player:SetAttribute("BirthdayJoinedWorld",true)
	player:SetAttribute("LobbyCountdownEnd",nil)
	character:SetAttribute("BirthdayPlacementReady",true)
	player:SetAttribute("BirthdayLocation","World")
	return true
end

local function onCharacter(player, character)
	local state = states[player]
	if not state then return end
	state.generation += 1
	local generation = state.generation
	state.deadline=nil
	state.moving=false
	character:SetAttribute("BirthdayPlacementReady",false)
	character:SetAttribute("BirthdayPlacementGeneration",generation)
	player:SetAttribute("BirthdayLocation","Loading")
	player:SetAttribute("LobbyCountdownEnd",nil)
	local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart",15)
	local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid",15)
	local function isCurrent()
		return player.Parent==Players and player.Character==character and states[player]==state and state.generation==generation and humanoid and humanoid.Health>0
	end
	if not root or not humanoid or not isCurrent() then return end
	-- CharacterAdded precedes appearance loading, parenting, rig scaling, and
	-- the engine's final spawn move. Wait on lifecycle facts, not a sleep delay.
	local needsAppearance=player.CanLoadCharacterAppearance and not StarterPlayer:FindFirstChild("StarterCharacter")
	while isCurrent() and (not character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) or (needsAppearance and state.appearanceCharacter~=character)) do
		RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
	end
	if not isCurrent() then return end
	RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
	if not isCurrent() then return end
	local slot = state.slot
	local start = lobbySpawn.CFrame * CFrame.new((slot % 4 - 1.5)*5,4,math.floor(slot/4)*4-2)
	local target=state.joined and destinationFor(player) or start
	player.RespawnLocation=state.joined and worldSpawn or lobbySpawn
	local function atTarget()
		local offset=root.Position-target.Position
		return Vector2.new(offset.X,offset.Z).Magnitude<2 and math.abs(offset.Y)<6
	end
	local placed=false
	for _=1,3 do
		if not isCurrent() then return end
		relocate(character,root,humanoid,target)
		RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
		if not isCurrent() then return end
		if atTarget() then
			RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
			if not isCurrent() then return end
			if atTarget() then placed=true;break end
		end
	end
	if not placed then
		warn("Birthday placement did not settle for "..player.Name.."; character remains Loading")
		return
	end
	character:SetAttribute("BirthdayPlacementReady",true)
	if state.joined then
		player:SetAttribute("BirthdayLocation","World")
		return
	end
	state.deadline = workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + countdownSeconds
	player:SetAttribute("BirthdayJoinedWorld",false)
	player:SetAttribute("LobbyCountdownEnd",state.deadline)
	player:SetAttribute("BirthdayLocation","Lobby")
	task.spawn(function()
		while states[player] == state and player.Character == character and state.generation == generation and not state.joined do
			if humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
			if state.deadline and workspace:GetServerTimeNow() >= state.deadline then
				if joinWorld(player,false) then return end
			end
			task.wait(.2)
		end
	end)
end

local function onPlayer(player)
	if states[player] then return end
	states[player] = {joined=false,moving=false,generation=0,slot=allocateSlot(player)}
	player:SetAttribute("BirthdaySpawnSlot",states[player].slot)
	player.RespawnLocation = lobbySpawn
	player:SetAttribute("BirthdayJoinedWorld",false)
	player:SetAttribute("BirthdayLocation","Loading")
	player:SetAttribute("LobbyCountdownEnd",nil)
	player.CharacterAppearanceLoaded:Connect(function(character)
		local state=states[player]
		if state and player.Character==character then state.appearanceCharacter=character end
	end)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character) onCharacter(player,character) end)
	player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(character)
		character:SetAttribute("BirthdayPlacementReady",false)
		local state=states[player]
		if state then state.generation+=1;state.deadline=nil;state.appearanceCharacter=nil end
		player:SetAttribute("LobbyCountdownEnd",nil)
		player:SetAttribute("BirthdayLocation","Loading")
	end)
	if player.Character then
		if player:HasAppearanceLoaded() then states[player].appearanceCharacter=player.Character end
		task.spawn(onCharacter,player,player.Character)
	end
end

prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player) joinWorld(player,true) end)
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayer)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	local state=states[player]
	if state then occupiedSlots[state.slot]=nil end
	states[player]=nil
end)
for _,player in Players:GetPlayers() do onPlayer(player) end

-- Shared front door. The server owns its state and checks interaction distance.
local home = workspace:WaitForChild("CozyWorld_Draft01"):WaitForChild("Home")
local door = home:WaitForChild("FrontDoor")
local prompt = home:WaitForChild("DoorInteraction"):WaitForChild("DoorPrompt")
local tweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local closed = door:GetPivot()
local isOpen, busy = false, false

prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if busy or not root or (root.Position - prompt.Parent.Position).Magnitude > 16 then return end
	busy = true
	prompt.Enabled = false
	isOpen = not isOpen
	local pose = Instance.new("CFrameValue")
	pose.Value = door:GetPivot()
	local changed = pose:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
		door:PivotTo(pose.Value)
	end)
	local target = isOpen and closed * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(100), 0) or closed
	local tween = tweenService:Create(pose, TweenInfo.new(.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), {Value=target})
	tween:Play()
	tween.Completed:Wait()
	changed:Disconnect()
	pose:Destroy()
	door:SetAttribute("Open", isOpen)
	prompt.ActionText = isOpen and "Close" or "Open"
	prompt.Enabled = true
	busy = false
end)

-- A north-facing starting view; the normal independently rotatable camera takes over.
local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local function frameArrival(character)
	local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
	camera.CameraSubject = humanoid
	camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 8, 17), root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, -22))
end
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(frameArrival)
if player.Character then frameArrival(player.Character) end

local animation = script:WaitForChild('Animation')
local humanoid = script.Parent:WaitForChild('Humanoid')
local dance = humanoid:LoadAnimation(animation)
dance:Play()

local animation = script:WaitForChild('Normal')
local humanoid = script.Parent:WaitForChild('Humanoid')
local origSpeed = script.Parent.Humanoid.WalkSpeed
local chaseSpeed = script.Parent.ChaseWalkspeed.Value
local dance = humanoid:LoadAnimation(animation)
dance:Play()
local dance2

if script.Parent.ChangeAnim.Value then
	local animation2 = script.Parent.ChangeAnim:WaitForChild("Chase")
	dance2 = humanoid:LoadAnimation(animation2)
end
script.Parent.Chasing.Changed:Connect(function()
	if script.Parent.ChangeAnim.Value then
		if script.Parent.Chasing.Value == true then
			script.Parent.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = chaseSpeed
			dance:Stop()
			dance2:Play()
		else
			script.Parent.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = origSpeed
			dance:Play()
			dance2:Stop()
		end
	else
		if script.Parent.Chasing.Value == true then
			script.Parent.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = chaseSpeed
			dance:AdjustSpeed(1.5)
		else
			script.Parent.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = origSpeed
			dance:AdjustSpeed(1)
		end
	end
end)

-- Install as StarterPlayerScripts.BirthdayLobbyClient.
-- Presentation only: the server supplies location and an absolute deadline.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "BirthdayLobbyHUD"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = false
gui.DisplayOrder = 5
gui.Enabled = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local card = Instance.new("Frame")
card.Name="CountdownCard";card.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,0);card.Position=UDim2.new(.5,0,0,12);card.Size=UDim2.new(.9,0,0,100)
card.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(245,240,228);card.BackgroundTransparency=.04;card.BorderSizePixel=0;card.Parent=gui
local corner=Instance.new("UICorner");corner.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,16);corner.Parent=card
local stroke=Instance.new("UIStroke");stroke.Color=Color3.fromRGB(168,185,149);stroke.Thickness=2;stroke.Parent=card
local size=Instance.new("UISizeConstraint");size.MaxSize=Vector2.new(410,100);size.MinSize=Vector2.new(270,100);size.Parent=card
local title=Instance.new("TextLabel");title.Name="CountdownText";title.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(16,9);title.Size=UDim2.new(1,-32,0,30)
title.BackgroundTransparency=1;title.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(54,87,68);title.TextSize=22;title.Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium;title.Parent=card
local hint=Instance.new("TextLabel");hint.Name="EarlyEntryHint";hint.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(16,41);hint.Size=UDim2.new(1,-32,0,35)
hint.BackgroundTransparency=1;hint.Text="Explore, or use the golden pad to enter now.";hint.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(38,56,46);hint.TextSize=15;hint.Font=Enum.Font.Gotham;hint.TextWrapped=true;hint.Parent=card
local track=Instance.new("Frame");track.Name="TimeTrack";track.Position=UDim2.new(0,18,1,-14);track.Size=UDim2.new(1,-36,0,5);track.BorderSizePixel=0;track.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(168,185,149);track.Parent=card
local fill=Instance.new("Frame");fill.Name="RemainingTime";fill.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1);fill.BorderSizePixel=0;fill.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(232,199,121);fill.Parent=track
local function layoutCountdown()
	local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
	local compact=camera and camera.ViewportSize.Y<500
	card.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,compact and 1 or 0)
	card.Position=compact and UDim2.new(.5,0,1,-14) or UDim2.new(.5,0,0,12)
	card.Size=UDim2.new(compact and .54 or .9,0,0,compact and 70 or 100)
	size.MinSize=compact and Vector2.new(240,70) or Vector2.new(270,100)
	size.MaxSize=compact and Vector2.new(360,70) or Vector2.new(410,100)
	corner.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,compact and 12 or 16)
	title.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(compact and 10 or 16,compact and 4 or 9)
	title.Size=UDim2.new(1,compact and -20 or -32,0,compact and 24 or 30)
	title.TextSize=compact and 18 or 22
	hint.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(compact and 10 or 16,compact and 29 or 41)
	hint.Size=UDim2.new(1,compact and -20 or -32,0,compact and 22 or 35)
	hint.TextSize=compact and 12 or 15
	track.Position=UDim2.new(0,compact and 12 or 18,1,compact and -8 or -14)
	track.Size=UDim2.new(1,compact and -24 or -36,0,compact and 4 or 5)
end
local viewportConnection
local function watchViewport()
	if viewportConnection then viewportConnection:Disconnect() end
	local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
	if camera then viewportConnection=camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(layoutCountdown) end
	layoutCountdown()
end
workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(watchViewport)
watchViewport()
local lastSecond
local totalSeconds=60
local world=workspace:WaitForChild("CozyWorld_Draft01")
local lobby=world:WaitForChild("BirthdayLobby")
totalSeconds=math.clamp(lobby:GetAttribute("CountdownSeconds") or 60,1,60)
local center=lobby:GetAttribute("RegionCenter")
local region=lobby:GetAttribute("RegionSize")
local outdoorLighting
local function restoreOutdoorLighting()
	if not outdoorLighting then return end
	for property,value in outdoorLighting do Lighting[property]=value end
	outdoorLighting=nil
end
local function updateRoomLighting()
	local location=player:GetAttribute("BirthdayLocation")
	if location=="World" then restoreOutdoorLighting();return end
	if location~="Lobby" or outdoorLighting then return end
	outdoorLighting={}
	for _,property in {"Brightness","Ambient","OutdoorAmbient","EnvironmentDiffuseScale","EnvironmentSpecularScale"} do
		outdoorLighting[property]=Lighting[property]
	end
	-- Per-client room lighting prevents the outdoor sun/sky splitting the room
	-- into blue and gold halves. Other players outside retain their world lighting.
	Lighting.Brightness=0
	Lighting.Ambient=Color3.fromRGB(118,110,100)
	Lighting.OutdoorAmbient=Color3.fromRGB(118,110,100)
	Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale=0
	Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale=0
end
player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("BirthdayLocation"):Connect(updateRoomLighting)
script.Destroying:Connect(restoreOutdoorLighting)
updateRoomLighting()
local function frameArrival()
	local location=player:GetAttribute("BirthdayLocation")
	if location~="Lobby" and location~="World" then return end
	local character=player.Character
	if not character then return end
	task.spawn(function()
		local root=character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart",10)
		local humanoid=character:WaitForChild("Humanoid",10)
		if not root or not humanoid then return end
		-- Wait for the server relocation to replicate before choosing the starting view.
		for _=1,30 do
			if player.Character~=character or player:GetAttribute("BirthdayLocation")~=location then return end
			local nearRoom=math.abs(root.Position.X-center.X)<region.X/2
			if character:GetAttribute("BirthdayPlacementReady")==true and ((location=="Lobby" and nearRoom) or (location=="World" and not nearRoom)) then break end
			RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
		end
		RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
		if player.Character~=character or player:GetAttribute("BirthdayLocation")~=location or character:GetAttribute("BirthdayPlacementReady")~=true then return end
		local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
		camera.CameraType=Enum.CameraType.Custom
		camera.CameraSubject=humanoid
		if location=="Lobby" then
			camera.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(root.Position+Vector3.new(0,7,8),Vector3.new(center.X,10,center.Z-30))
		else
			camera.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(root.Position+Vector3.new(0,7,14),root.Position+Vector3.new(0,3,-16))
		end
	end)
end
player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("BirthdayLocation"):Connect(frameArrival)
frameArrival()
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	local character=player.Character
	local root=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local deadline=player:GetAttribute("LobbyCountdownEnd")
	local offset=root and root.Position-center
	local inside=offset and math.abs(offset.X)<=region.X/2 and math.abs(offset.Z)<=region.Z/2 and math.abs(offset.Y)<=region.Y/2
	local visible=player:GetAttribute("BirthdayLocation")=="Lobby" and type(deadline)=="number" and humanoid and humanoid.Health>0 and character:GetAttribute("BirthdayPlacementReady")==true and inside
	gui.Enabled=visible and true or false
	if not visible then lastSecond=nil;return end
	local remaining=math.clamp(deadline-workspace:GetServerTimeNow(),0,totalSeconds)
	local second=math.ceil(remaining)
	if second~=lastSecond then
		lastSecond=second
		title.Text=second>0 and string.format("Your world opens in %ds",second) or "Entering the birthday world..."
	end
	fill.Size=UDim2.fromScale(remaining/totalSeconds,1)
end)

-- A north-facing starting view; the normal independently rotatable camera takes over.
local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local function frameArrival(character)
	local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

	camera.CameraSubject = humanoid
	camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 8, 17), root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, -22))
end
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(frameArrival)
if player.Character then frameArrival(player.Character) end
